videos.title: How Is Steel Made? (Hotter Than Lava) 🔥
videos.description:
Rusty rock, coal and limestone go into a blast furnace. The iron that pours out is brittle, so pure oxygen is blasted in faster than sound to burn the carbon away in a storm of sparks. Then it's cast and squashed into sheets. Almost 2 billion tons a year, and the most recycled material on Earth.
Name one thing with no steel in it 👇
